title: D\'ecoupage: Directorial Audio-Visual Control for Long Multi-Shot Video Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.18866v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In cinematic storytelling, sound and visual transitions do not always coincide in lockstep: dialogue frequently bridges across cuts to reveal reactions or introduces new scenes via J- and L-cuts, while deliberate silences pace the scene. Existing audio-visual generative frameworks, however, lack explicit mechanisms to coordinate independent visual and acoustic timing over extended horizons. As narrative duration and shot complexity scale, these systems struggle to maintain long-range dialogue pacing, often hallucinating speech during intended silences or erroneously driving mouth movements on silent listeners. To enable fine-grained cinematic control, we present DECOUPAGE, a screenplay-driven framework for long-form, multi-shot, and multi-character joint audio-video generation. translated_title: Découpage：面向长篇多镜头视频生成的导演式视听控制
translated_abstract: 在电影化叙事中，声音与视觉转场并不总是同步进行：对话常常跨越剪辑点延续，以呈现角色反应，或通过J-cut与L-cut引入新场景，而刻意的静默则用于把控场景节奏。然而，现有的视听生成框架缺乏在长时间跨度上协调相互独立的视觉时序与声学时序的显式机制。随着叙事时长与镜头复杂度的提升，这些系统难以维持长程对话节奏，常常在本应静默时“幻听”出语音，或错误地让沉默的聆听者做出口型动作。为实现细粒度的电影化控制，我们提出了DÉCOUPAGE——一个由剧本驱动的长篇、多镜头、多角色音视频联合生成框架。DÉCOUPAGE并非默认将各模态边界耦合在一起，而是将生成过程解耦为具有独立边界的视觉轨道与声学轨道，并由持续的上下文加以调控（注：原摘要在此处不完整）。
tldr: 该论文提出剧本驱动的DÉCOUPAGE框架，通过将视觉轨道与声学轨道解耦为各自独立限定时序边界的生成过程，实现长篇、多镜头、多角色的联合音视频生成，并支持对话跨镜头延续（J/L-cut）与刻意静默等电影化精细控制。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes DÉCOUPAGE, a screenplay-driven framework that decouples generation into independently bounded visual and acoustic tracks, enabling long-form, multi-shot, multi-character joint audio-video generation with fine-grained cinematic controls such as cross-cut dialogue (J/L-cuts) and deliberate silences.
